title: Play with friends
fact: Castle Crashers Remastered supports up to four players, locally or online.

title: Playable roster
fact: The official Castle Crashers game page describes a roster of more than 25 characters.

title: Weapons
fact: The official game page says there are more than 40 weapons.

title: Character progression
fact: Players can level up and allocate points to Strength, Magic, Defense, and Agility.

title: Animal Orbs
fact: Animal Orbs accompany players and provide different abilities.

title: Arena mode
fact: Arena mode lets players battle one another in free-for-all or team matches.

title: Back Off Barbarian
fact: Back Off Barbarian is a minigame in Castle Crashers Remastered where players avoid enemies by jumping and hopping across the level.

title: Insane Mode
fact: Insane Mode is an extra challenging version of the campaign.

title: Remastered edition
fact: The Behemoth says Castle Crashers Remastered runs at 60 FPS and 1080p on Xbox One, compared with 30 FPS and 720p for the Xbox 360 edition.

title: Painter Boss Paradise
fact: The Painter Boss Paradise DLC released on Steam in August 2025 and introduced Paint Junior, updated character and weapon artwork, and custom character creation.

title: The King
fact: The King Pack introduced the King as a playable character and gave him healing magic that can heal himself or other players.

title: Strength stat
fact: Strength is one of the four attributes players can increase when leveling up.

title: Classic content in Remastered
fact: The Behemoth says Castle Crashers Remastered retains the classic story, levels, arenas, and characters.

title: All You Can Quaff
fact: The Xbox 360 edition included the All You Can Quaff minigame; the Xbox One Remastered comparison lists Back Off Barbarian instead.

title: Painter Boss Paradise release
fact: The Painter Boss Paradise DLC released on August 6, 2025. The Behemoth says it is available on Steam because sharing creations relies on Steam Workshop.

title: Custom character creation
fact: Painter Boss Paradise adds custom character capabilities that let players create their own characters.

title: Updated artwork
fact: Painter Boss Paradise includes updated artwork for playable characters and weapons, plus new map and main menu art.
